status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Aleppo and Quneitra.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Aleppo og Quneitra.

summary.en: Landmines continue to explode in Idlib countryside, killing children and injuring others, while a mine-clearing operation in Deir ez-Zor killed a Syrian soldier and wounded two. Lebanese army forces seized 264 kilograms of explosives near the border and Syrian anti-narcotics officials destroyed a large captagon shipment, showing ongoing cross-border illicit trade. Russian air strikes hit Aleppo, killing three children, and the United Nations recognized Syria’s anti-drug and anti-crime efforts. The interim Syrian government is attempting to integrate thousands of foreign fighters into its security forces, a development not noted in the previous briefing. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Landminer fortsetter å eksplodere på landsbygda i Idlib, og dreper barn og skader andre, mens en mineryddingsoperasjon i Deir ez-Zor drepte en syrisk soldat og såret to. Libanesiske hærstyrker beslagla 264 kilogram sprengstoff nær grensen, og syriske narkotikakontrollmyndigheter ødela en stor captagon-forsendelse, noe som viser pågående grenseoverskridende ulovlig handel. Russiske luftangrep rammet Aleppo og drepte tre barn, og FN anerkjente Syriens innsats mot narkotika og kriminalitet. Den midlertidige syriske regjeringen prøver å integrere tusenvis av utenlandske krigere i sikkerhetsstyrkene, en utvikling som ikke ble nevnt i forrige briefing. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
